messages:
maria: Heads-up: Async Generation + Toolflow (async-toolflow-v1) is GA on Hosted API as of today. Launch internal-only first, external announcement after 2h. :tada:

maria: Why this matters: stable job-based async API for long-running generations and tool orchestrations (think retrieval+tool chains) with better retry semantics and cheaper tail cost compared to long-lived streams.

kevin: Quick technical summary: new endpoint `POST /v1/async/generate` returns 202 + job_id. Poll `GET /v1/async/job/{job_id}` or subscribe to SSE at `/v1/async/stream/{job_id}`. Webhook deliveries supported via `callbacks.url` in request.

kevin: Important wire change vs old webhook beta: the job payload uses `job_schema.v1` and the tool outputs are embedded in `artifacts[]` rather than inline events. This makes retries idempotent and lets us store artifacts for 7 days by default.

jenna: Billing note: there's a new billing metric `async_job_unit`. Jobs shorter than 30s are billed at a flat micro-job rate; longer jobs meter tokens per-second. Finance will publish pricing tiers; we have a 60-day grandfathering window for existing webhook beta customers.

doc-bot: Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/async-toolflow-v1-migration  includes samples for polling, SSE, and webhook callback verification.

infra-bot: Rollout plan: canary in us-east-1 (1h), then us-west-2 (3h), eu-central-1 (6h). Were enabling feature flag `async_toolflow_v1` for hosted customers progressively. Ops will monitor `async.job.latency`, `async.job.failures`, and `toolflow.artifact.missing`.

ops-rotations: Runbook updated: if `async.job.failures` > 3% for 10m or 10+ `artifact.missing` events in 15m, page eng-oncall. Also monitor callback delivery 5xx rate.

maria: SDK impact: Node/Python SDKs will add `client.async.generate()` + helpers for webhook signature verification. Old streaming SDKs remain unchanged.

kevin: Quick smoke test (polling):
```
# submit job
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-longtail-7b","input":"Generate a 2k token article","tools":[{"name":"wiki.fetch","input":{"page":"reinforcement_learning"}}]}'
# response -> {"job_id":"job_ABC123"}
# poll
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/job/job_ABC123 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
```

maria: Notes for CS: prepare FAQ covering webhook verification, artifact retention, and pricing. Jenna, can your team draft a one-pager by EOD?

jenna: Yep, Ill get a draft up in #customer-readouts and flag enterprise customers for manual outreach.

kevin: Perf note: for multi-tool pipelines were observing ~12% lower tail cost vs equivalent streaming sessions in internal tests. We also lowered peak memory by serializing intermediate artifacts to object storage.

maria: Action items: docs owner to publish migration guide (doc-bot), SDK leads to ship helpers (kevin), CS to draft customer comms (jenna), infra to watch canary metrics (infra-bot/ops-rotations).

infra-bot: Canary status at 2134567955: us-east-1 canary healthy, no alert conditions. Proceeding with staged rollout.

maria: Thanks all  external blog + changelog update scheduled after full global rollout completes. Ping here for any escalation.
